name: Aratoca (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal seal of Aratoca (the arms within a ring inscribed MUNICIPIO DE ARATOCA, with the motto LABORIOSA Y PACIFISTA).
history: Municipal flag of Aratoca, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Aratoca seal — arms within a ring inscribed MUNICIPIO DE ARATOCA, with motto LABORIOSA Y PACIFISTA
